ns0:problem.ns0:para: Shanthie needs to earn at least $500 a week during her summer break to pay for college. She works two jobs. One as a swimming instructor that pays $10 an hour and the other as an intern in a law office for $25 hour. How many hours does Shanthie need to work at each job to earn at least $500 per week?

ⓐ Let x be the number of hours she works teaching swimming and let y be the number of hours she works as an intern. Write an inequality that would model this situation. ⓑ Graph the inequality. ⓒ Find three ordered pairs (x,y) that would be solutions to the inequality. Then, explain what that means for Shanthie.
